text: なにげに　スプーンを　なげたら　まがって　いらい…　わたし　エスパー　しょうじょ　なの　たたかうの　すき　じゃない　けど　あなたが　のぞむ　なら　わたしの　ちから　みせて　あげる！
note: Spoon bending is the stock image of psychic power in Japan, since Uri Geller's television appearances there in 1974 set off a nationwide craze, with children claiming they could bend spoons too.
claim: Uri Geller's 1974 appearances on Japanese television triggered a spoon-bending and psychic-power boom in Japan.
